text:
maria: Heads up — Vercel preview for PR #482 is rendering broken SDK snippets (code blocks empty). Locally `mkdocs serve` looks fine. Anyone seen env var or build-step differences that cause this?
dan: did you check build logs on Vercel? sometimes we forget to add NEXT_PUBLIC_* envs to the preview scope.
maria: looking now, but I think it's not an API url issue — the templates themselves are missing markup after the build step.
shiva: could be a post-processing step that runs via Netlify/Vercel plugin. On Vercel we run `yarn docs:build` then a small script that copies assets. If that script checks for DOCS_BASE_URL it may early-exit.
ellen: quick idea — add a defensive fallback in the templates: `{{ env.DOCS_BASE_URL || "/" }}` so previews don't break if the env is absent. low-risk patch for docs.
docs-ci: build error (Vercel preview): `Error: Missing environment variable NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL at build time` — stack trace: ```/usr/src/docs/build/index.mjs:45:12
at Object.require (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:874:14)
```
maria: interesting, the CI log shows two issues: the missing NEXT_PUBLIC var and a failing post-build copy step that returns exit code 1. I can try the fallback patch + add the missing env to the Vercel project preview envs.
dan: to check envs from CLI: `vercel env ls --scope redwood-inference` and `vercel env pull .env.preview` — will help replicate locally.
shiva: if you want a quick local repro without touching Vercel, run: ```bash
yarn docs:build
node scripts/copy-assets.js || true # ignore failure to see rendered output
python -m http.server -d site 8000
```
maria: thanks. I'll push a tiny template fallback in a new commit. @ellen can you review asap? I want to avoid disrupting the merge window (we have a queued release at 16:00 UTC).
deploy-bot: Preview deployment complete — https://vercel.com/redwood-inference/docs/preview/deploy_98765 (build 98765). Status: failed (post-build).
ellen: pinged — I'll take a look now, should be quick. If it's only the fallback and an env add we can merge in the 15:30 PT slot.
dan: added note in PR: how to reproduce locally + `vercel env pull` snippet.
maria: commit pushed: small fallback; also added a CI note to avoid exiting on the copy script. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/files#diff-...
docs-ci: re-run requested by @maria — preview rebuild queued (build 98766).
deploy-bot: Preview deployment started (build 98766).
ellen: reviewing now, left one tiny comment about whitespace. otherwise LGTM.
maria: perfect — I'll merge during the 15:30 PT merge window. tagging reviewers and release lead. :thumbsup:
shiva: if anything still fails, we can revert the copy script change and keep the fallback. low blast radius.
maria: thanks all, will ping #release-war-room at merge time.
